fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://devirgames.com/rock-hard. The English Devir product page identifies Rock Hard: 1977 and shows the base-game box covered by this rule record. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently sang in the shower starts, or choose a first player by any other method.
clarifications: Place the first player’s guitar-pick turn-order token on the first space; the remaining players fill the track clockwise.
Starting with the first player, each player draws two Character cards and chooses one simultaneously with the others.
